section.title: Purpose
section.text: N-14 gives a run a place to work: a git worktree in the numbered slot that belongs to one pool user, cut from origin/main (or from the ticket's branch on a later attempt, or detached at a pull request head for a reviewer), opened to that user by ACL, after verifying that the ticket holds live claims covering its files.

It replaces branches cut from whatever the checkout held (memory work-order-start-branches-from-checkout-head), a start path that dirtied the main checkout (rebuild/investigation/01-ROOT-CAUSES.md#3-root-causes RC3), and a slot pool whose lease nothing enforced (L02 section 5 item 7). The owner's main checkout is never touched.

Claims are acquired once, by N-03 at ready, in the one claims table (../../shared/contracts.xml#claims); the file_claims table of book 1.0.0 is deleted. This node is the last check before a seat can write: the ticket must still hold its claims.

section.title: Input record: dispatch
section.text: Kind dispatch, code 100, from N-07; schema ../N-07/record.schema.json#/$defs/dispatch ($ref'd as this node's dispatch def). Fields used: dispatch_id (the run id), ticket, phase, role (gate is skipped), attempt, lease, repo, repo_sha, target (pr and head_sha for a reviewer). The validator (N-18) calls Provision in process with role validator and run id v-SET_ID for a read-only borrow at origin/main.

section.title: Output records: workspace, workspace.refused, workspace.failed
section.text: All on the shared committed envelope; operation key N-14/workspace.provision/DISPATCH_ID/r1 on the Commit request; the Commit carries the dispatch lease.
section.field: run_id, ticket, role, path (CACHE/ws/SLOT/), slot, seat_user (coq-seat-NN, the only user that may hold slot NN), branch (wo/TICKET for a worker), base_sha, base_ref, mode (write for a worker, read-only otherwise, enforced by ACL), mirror_sha, claims_verified (the claim rows read in the provision transaction; at least one for a worker, none for other roles), expires_at.

412 claim_missing (the ticket holds no live claim for a declared pattern; failure_kind workspace.refused) or head_moved (the PR head no longer equals target.head_sha); 429 no_slot (failure_kind cap, also when the slot pool is under a live drain lease). All are free regrants by N-11 (../../shared/contracts.xml#retry-owner).
500 after three tries of a step: store_unreachable, mirror_locked, fetch_failed, clone_failed, acl_failed, io; charged by N-11 with session new.
section.text: Schemas: record.schema.json#/$defs/workspace, #/$defs/workspace.refused, #/$defs/workspace.failed. Examples in section examples.

section.title: Mechanism: claims verified, slot, mirror, worktree, ACL
section.text: Package scheduler/internal/workspace. Provision(ctx, dispatch) (workspace, error). Git runs as a child process with a timeout per call; every argv, exit and stderr tail goes to the run's provision.log.
section.mermaid: flowchart TD D[dispatch, phase not gate, no workspace for run_id] --> C{ticket holds live claims covering its files?} C -- no --> R412[workspace.refused 412 claim_missing] C -- yes --> S{slots.take: a free slot, no live drain lease} S -- none --> R429[workspace.refused 429 no_slot] S -- slot n --> F[fetch in the bare mirror under a flock] F --> W[worktree add at base_ref; worker switches to wo/TICKET] W --> A[setfacl: coq-seat-n rwX for a worker, r-X otherwise] A --> V[verify HEAD, clean status, ACL read back] V --> P[Commit workspace with N-14/workspace.provision/run_id/r1] F -- 3 failures --> R500[workspace.failed 500, slots.free]
section.step: Claims verified. In one read transaction, list the live claims rows of the ticket (released_at null) and check each declared pattern of the ticket row has one. A missing row is 412 claim_missing with the missing patterns: N-03 re-acquires at the next ready and N-11 regrants free. A reviewer, spec-author or validator claims nothing and verifies nothing. No row is written here.

Slot. A slot with a live drain lease (system lease key drain:slot-NN, nodes/N-45/spec.xml#mechanism step 3) is never taken; when every free slot is drained, refuse 429 no_slot, so N-45 can empty the pool. Otherwise statement slots.take: one free, undrained row of workspace_slots (../../shared/contracts.xml#timing) to holder run_id with expires_at the dispatch deadline_at plus kill.grace_seconds plus 600 s. Slot n is only ever used by pool user coq-seat-n, so the slot number names the seat user N-15 binds.
Mirror. One bare mirror per repository at CACHE/git/SLUG.git, owned by coq-svc. Under a flock (30 s) run git fetch --prune with refspecs for heads and refs/pull/*/head; record mirror_sha.

Worktree. Remove any leftover at ws/n, then worktree add --detach at base_ref: origin/main for a worker on attempt 1, a spec-author and the validator; origin/wo/TICKET for a worker on a later attempt whose branch exists; refs/pull/PR/head for a reviewer, which must equal target.head_sha or the result is 412 head_moved. A worker switches to wo/TICKET.

ACL. ws/n stays owned by coq-svc; setfacl gives coq-seat-n rwX plus a matching default ACL for a worker, r-X for every other role (../../shared/authority.xml#seat-isolation). A reviewer or spec-author therefore cannot change a file whatever its settings say; the deny rules of N-13 are a second fence, not the first.

Verify and record. HEAD equals base_sha; status is clean; getfacl reads back the intended entries. Commit the workspace record under the dispatch lease. A 412 stale_token or lease_not_current means the lease ended: slots.free and stop.
section.text: Branch names: wo/TICKET, one branch per ticket for all its attempts. The worktree has no remote push credential: pushes are N-16's, from the mirror, as coq-svc with forge-pr.

section.title: How it starts without an agent typing
section.text: The seat controller goroutine lists dispatches with phase not gate, a reserved or running lease and no workspace record, and calls Provision for each, in parallel with N-13. Nothing here is started by a prompt, a pane or a person.

section.title: Every wait, its timeout and its fallback

wait.what: store read of claims and slots.take

wait.fallback: workspace.failed 500 mirror_locked; the holder's pid is in the lock file

wait.what: git worktree add, switch, setfacl, verify
wait.fallback: workspace.failed 500 clone_failed or acl_failed; the slot directory is removed and slots.free
workspace.refused 429 at once; N-11 regrants on the next tick with capacity

section.text: Bound per dispatch about 7 minutes in the worst case of three slow fetches; a reserved lease that outlives start.grace_seconds expires and N-11 regrants it free.

section.title: Retries up to 3, then recover and report
section.text: Git and ACL steps retry 3 times with the backoff above, then workspace.failed 500 with failure_body, slots.free, and stop; N-11 charges it with session new. Refusals are not retried here: N-11 regrants them free. On restart the controller re-lists dispatches without a workspace; a slot whose holder's run:RUN_ID is closed_out or failed_spawn, or whose expires_at passed with no live lease, is reclaimed with slots.free and its directory removed. Claims are never released by this node.

section.title: Many agents at once
section.text: Twenty provisions in one tick run in a pool of seats.json provision_workers (default 4), serialized only on the mirror fetch.

Overlapping files: impossible at this point, because N-03 acquires claims with the two-way prefix check inside the ready transition (../../shared/contracts.xml#claims); this node verifies they are still held.

Two passes provision one dispatch: the operation key admits one Commit; slots.take is keyed by run_id, so the loser gets the same slot back or a replay; an unrecorded leftover directory is removed on the next pass.
Two fetches at once: the flock serializes them; a mirror fetched within 10 s is not fetched again.

A reviewer while the worker's branch moves: the reviewer is detached at the head sha in its dispatch; a new head is a new gate and a new reviewer dispatch; a moved head at provision is 412 head_moved.
Cleanup and a live run on one slot: N-45 removes a slot only after slots.free succeeds, which refuses a slot whose holder's lease is reserved or running.

section.title: Status codes this node emits
section.code: Provisioned. Acts: N-15 when the seat.bundle also exists.
claim_missing, head_moved. Acts: N-11 free regrant after retry.claim_seconds.
no_slot (failure_kind cap). Acts: N-11 free regrant on the next tick with capacity.
store_unreachable, mirror_locked, fetch_failed, clone_failed, acl_failed, io. Acts: N-11 charges it.

section.title: State paths and the cleanup script for each

path.retention: kept; git gc --prune weekly; worktree prune every run

section.path: Dry run by default; --apply runs gc and prune; never while any slot has a live holder.

path.writes: the worktree, its ACL and its provision record
path.retention: removed when the run is closed_out or failed_spawn and the ticket is merged, dead or cancelled, or 24 h after closed_out

section.path: Dry run lists slot, holder, run, branch, dirty state; --apply removes only slots whose slots.free succeeds; a dirty worktree with unpushed commits is kept and reported, never deleted silently.

path.writes: git argv, exit codes, stderr tails

section.text: $COQ_CACHE resolves through bin/state-root.sh (default ${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/coq/coq-jev-herdr-plugin), mode 0700 coq-svc. Nothing under it is ever committed (C35).

section.title: Permissions
section.text: The Go service, principal coq-svc acting as N-14: read and write CACHE/ws and CACHE/git; run git and setfacl; network to origin for fetch only; statements slots.take and slots.free; Commits of the three kinds. No forge token is needed to provision.

A seat: receives ws/n as its cwd from the launcher; may write only where its slot ACL allows (a worker's slot) and only allow_paths there (N-13); never runs git worktree, git switch to another branch, treehouse or rm of the slot. A seat that needs another workspace reports blocked.

section.title: Checklist with proof

item.proof: go test ./internal/workspace -run TestClaimMissingRefused: a worker ticket whose claim row was released returns workspace.refused 412 claim_missing naming the pattern; no claims row is written by this node

section.item: Claims are verified, never acquired here.

item.proof: go test TestConcurrentProvisionOneSlot: 20 concurrent Provision calls against a pool of 16 yield 16 workspace records, 4 refused 429, 16 distinct slots, each slot n bound to coq-seat-n

section.item: Slots are one per pool user.

item.proof: go test TestDrainRefuses: a slot with a live drain:slot-NN lease is skipped, and with every free slot drained Provision returns 429 no_slot
host probe: as coq-seat-03 in a reviewer slot, touch of any file fails EACCES; as coq-seat-04 in a worker slot it succeeds

section.item: Read-only roles are read-only by ACL.

item.proof: go test TestBaseRefByPhase: attempt 1 worker at origin/main; attempt 2 at origin/wo/WO-x; reviewer at refs/pull/N/head equal to target.head_sha; a moved head returns 412 head_moved

section.item: Base ref follows the phase and attempt.

item.proof: probe: git -C the owner's checkout status --porcelain before and after 50 provisions is byte-identical

section.item: The main checkout is never touched.

item.proof: probe: a fetch with origin unreachable returns workspace.failed 500 fetch_failed after 3 attempts and the slot is free again

section.item: Fetch failure is bounded and releases the slot.

item.proof: scheduler/host/bin/cleanup-workspaces.sh --dry-run lists a merged slot as removable and a dirty slot as kept; --apply removes only the first

section.title: Monitoring
section.text: Counters: workspaces_provisioned, workspaces_refused_claim_missing, workspaces_refused_slot, workspaces_failed, slots_in_use, provision_seconds histogram, mirror_fetch_seconds. The Machine screen (N-39) for this node shows slots in use over the pool as a belt occupancy. A 429 streak longer than seats.json slot_starvation_seconds (default 900) is an alert on N-41 because capacity, not seats, is the defect (D17 option B).

section.title: Runbook
section.text: See slots: scheduler status (gRPC Status) lists slots with holder, run, ticket, since. See a workspace (as the owner through ctl; COQ_CACHE is 0700 coq-svc): cat $COQ_CACHE/ws/<slot>.json; git -C $COQ_CACHE/ws/<slot> status; getfacl $COQ_CACHE/ws/<slot>.
Mirror stuck under its lock: the lock file names the pid; if the pid is gone, the next Provision pass removes the stale lock (flock releases on process death anyway); never delete the mirror by hand.

Cleanup: scheduler/host/bin/cleanup-workspaces.sh [--apply] [--slot N]; scheduler/host/bin/cleanup-git-mirror.sh [--apply]. Both run from N-45's timer; a hand run is the owner's break glass and is recorded by the script as a cleanup.run with by owner.
A dirty slot that cleanup keeps: the record names the branch and the unpushed commits; the disposition is a card (N-28) with options land as a pull request or discard; never discarded by the script.

section.title: DAG edges in and out

edge.record: workspace.refused 412 and 429, workspace.failed 500 (failure records with failure_body)

section.text: N-18 calls Provision in process for its read-only borrow; not a drawn edge. Claims are N-03's (../../shared/contracts.xml#claims); this node returns nothing to N-03.
